Catfish and the Bottlemen - Anything
The Ride *2016*

Listen to the song for timings but it should be easily tabbed throughout, feel free to point out
any mistakes and enjoy playing this mega tune.

| x   Dead note
| g   Grace note
| (n) Ghost note
| h   Hammer-on
| p   Pull-off
| r   Release
| >   Accented note
| t   Tapping
| b   Bend
| br  Bend release
| pb  Pre-bend
| pbr Pre-bend release
| /   Slide up
| \   Slide down
| ~   Vibrato
| s   Slap
| P   Pop
| PM  Palm mute
| TR  Trill
| N   Tremolo
